# Replit — Growrix OS v2

This branch (`replit/agentic-env`) is the Replit copy of the agentic system. Claude Code on Windows is the source; nothing here changes it. Do not merge this branch into the source branch or `main`.

## How the system works on Replit

- **Replit Agent** reads this file and the skills in `.agents/skills/`. It shows each skill's name and description and loads the full skill when a task needs it.
  - Project skills have the same names as in Claude Code (for example `system-builder`, `frontend-quality-standard`).
  - Each Claude Code agent is a role skill named `agent-<name>` (for example `agent-senior-dev`, `agent-site-planner`). Where a role says to delegate to another agent, load that agent's role skill and do that part yourself.
- **Claude Code in the Replit shell** loads `.claude/` as on Windows. Its hooks run with bash (`.claude/hooks/*.sh`) and need `jq`.

## Workflows (Claude Code slash commands)

Replit Agent has no slash commands. Ask for the workflow by name, or attach the matching skill:

- `/audit-project` — Full senior-web-dev audit of an existing (or newly built) project. Runs project-auditor + 8 specialist auditors sequentially, pools findings by severity, hands user the triage decision, delegates approved fixes via bug-fixer. Works on any project you've copied .claude/ into.
- `/fix-until-green` — Run code-review → fix → re-review until clean or 5-iteration budget hits. Vendor-neutral; works on whichever product's working tree you're in.
- `/new-product` — Kick off a new SaaS product. Invokes the project-director, which asks you to fill the stack manifest with every slot empty.
- `/plan-ui` — Hand a frontend planning task to the site-planner — art direction, motion and creative plan first (Stage A), then /prototype, then `/plan-ui <slug> finalize` for the production spec (wireframes, content schemas, budgets, QA) for a site, page, section or redesign. Plans only; the finished plan is built afterwards with /senior-dev.
- `/prototype` — Build or refine a single-file HTML prototype of a page so you can see the design before production, or study reference sites with `study <slug> <urls>`. Runs the prototype-builder procedure in this session, opens the result in the browser pane, and screenshots it.
- `/retrospective` — After a project ships, mine the capability-dev reports for adapter-skill material. Vendor-neutral by design.
- `/senior-dev` — Hand any ongoing task to the senior-dev — a senior web developer that triages, plans, edits small changes itself, delegates the rest to the right sub-agents one at a time, verifies against the project's gates, and reports. Third workflow beside /new-product (build) and /audit-project (audit).
- `/status` — Show the current project phase, gates passed, and the next action.
- `/triage` — Run support-triager against the current inbound queue. Classifies, labels, assigns owners, and summarizes.

## Guards

Replit Agent runs no hooks, so these rules are not enforced automatically. Follow them:

- Never run `rm -rf`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -f`, force-push, or push to `main`/`master`.
- Never run destructive SQL or reset a database.
- Never deploy to production without the user's explicit approval.
- Never create or edit `.env*` files, keys or credentials; only `.env.example`. Secrets go in Replit Secrets.
- Never edit `.claude/`, `.agents/skills/` or this file here. They are generated from the Claude Code source; change the agentic system there and re-sync.

In the Replit shell with Claude Code, the bash hooks enforce these rules.

## Project rules (from CLAUDE.md)

## Growrix OS v2 — marketing site

Rules for every agent working in this repo. Read before editing.

### Stack (pinned in `package.json`; see `docs/adr/0001-homepage-stack.md`)

- Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5 (`strict: true`)
- Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS-first `@theme` in `app/globals.css`), `next/font/google`, `next/image`
- Sanity: read via `next-sanity` + `@sanity/image-url`; Studio lives in `sanity/` (own `package.json`, hosted Studio, never embedded in the app)
- `zod` (chat API validation), `@heroicons/react` (outline 24, per-icon imports), `@vercel/speed-insights` (loaded after idle)
- Dev/QA: ESLint 9 flat config + `eslint-config-next`, Prettier + tailwind plugin, Playwright + axe, `size-limit` + `@size-limit/file`
- Hosting: Vercel, **preview only** for the homepage slice (D-027). Every non-production deploy sends `noindex`.

### The spec

The homepage is built from `docs/frontend-plans/homepage/` (start at `INDEX.md`). The plan files are the spec. Never invent a decision the plan does not make; report gaps. Never edit `docs/frontend-plans/**`.

### Layout

App at the repo root (no `src/`): `app/`, `components/{ui,layout,sections,trust,chat}`, `lib/{cms,seo,analytics,utils}`, `sanity/` (Studio workspace, schemas, seed), `tests/` (Playwright), `scripts/`.

### Locked constraints (change only with the user's explicit approval)

- Performance budgets in `docs/frontend-plans/homepage/90-performance.md` (first-load JS <= 130 KB **brotli** per D-032 — the plan file still says gzip until a `/plan-ui` revision; chat chunk separate <= 20 KB, CSS <= 30 KB gzip, <= 2 font families / <= 3 woff2, LCP image <= 100 KB, HTML <= 120 KB).
- The homepage must be static (shown as `○` in the `next build` route table): no `cookies()`, `headers()`, `searchParams` in it.
- No motion library (`motion`/`framer-motion`, `gsap`, `lenis`), no `clsx`/`tailwind-merge`, no `@headlessui/react`, no focus-trap packages, no `zustand` (`91-stack.md` §2).
- Client islands are only those listed in `91-stack.md` §3 (approved under D-013). Everything else is a Server Component.
- No hardcoded content in `components/**`: copy comes from Sanity; no raw hex, px font sizes, `http` URLs or prices in components (BG-3).
- Never render `{{...}}` placeholder text; empty CMS field -> the component renders nothing (R-01, R-03).
- No new dependency without the user's approval. Never edit `.env*` (only `.env.example`).

### Gate (0 failures before any report of "done")

```
npm run ci:check   # lint + typecheck + build + size + scan:content
npm run test:e2e   # Playwright + axe against `next start` (needs browsers installed)
```

Never weaken, skip or delete a test, budget or lint rule to get green. No push, PR or deploy without the user's explicit approval.

### Commits

Conventional Commits, scope = area (`feat(web): ...`, `feat(studio): ...`, `chore(deps): ...`). Never `--no-verify`.
